metadata.title: Smooth structures on polyhedral products of disks and spheres
metadata.abstract: We prove that every polyhedral product of disks and their boundary spheres that is a topological manifold admits a stably parallelizable smooth structure. We also show that if a moment-angle complex or a real moment-angle complex admits a smooth structure for which the coordinate action is smooth, then the link of every face of the underlying simplicial complex is a simplicial sphere, and every such smooth structure is stably parallelizable.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 多面体积的可光滑性与稳定平行化
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明由圆盘及其边界球面构成的多面体积，只要本身是拓扑流形，就有稳定可平行化的光滑结构。若moment-angle或实moment-angle复形已有使坐标作用光滑的结构，则底单纯复形每个面的link为单纯球面，且每个这样的光滑结构均稳定可平行化。
analysis.breakthrough: 一般多面体积给出存在性，并在坐标作用光滑的情形对所有此类结构取得稳定平行化结论。
analysis.limitations: 第二项要求坐标作用也光滑，不能省去。link条件涉及底单纯复形的每个面。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
